title: Agent interface for end users - Cubric Studio as an MCP server for Claude, Codex and Gemini
description: MCP-FIRST since 2026-09-25 (Fabio): the app serves MCP at 127.0.0.1:3000/mcp and a tiny .mcpb bridge covers Claude Desktop, so non-coders install it from their agent's own extension directory. The CLI is dropped. A USER never types a command (Fabio 2026-09-17). Phase 1 spike DONE (a cold Claude Code agent made an image unaided); phase 2 = safe for users (cost check, reference images, results the agent can see), phase 3 = ship and list. brief.md / plan.md.
